spans.text: My death will not change anything.
Sooner or later, she will head to the destined place and meet the one who has long awaited her arrival.
Then rest in peace with that delusion of yours.
Bang!
The dark figure lights up in a blaze, illuminating everyone's faces.
The leaves in the garden rustle for a while before growing still and silent again.
The Sangvis signal named "Elisa" is no more.
Let's go. M4 should be in there.
M16 turns around and finds three Dolls gawking at her with strange expressions.
What's wrong?
I knew we might see you here, but now that you're standing right here in the flesh...
Waaaaahhh!!!
Unable to suppress her feelings anymore, SOP-II leaps into M16's arms.
16! I missed you so much!
What are you doing? This is hardly necessary.
ST AR-15 walks up to them but makes no attempt to peel SOP-II off M16.
Welcome back, 16.
You'll have to excuse us. We've all missed you badly ever since you sacrificed yourself during that mission...
Sacrificed myself?
M16 frowns at the incongruity of RO's words.
What do you mean?
You know... Back at the Paldiski Submarine Base...
The Starfish System gave out so much energy when it activated that the underground levels completely collapsed. We only had time to get M4 out...
To save M4, you stayed down there.
Why are you giving me that look? Don't you remember?
After I... sacrificed myself, what happened?
We withdrew from Paldiski, and what M4 saw within the Starfish System became our bargaining chip.
But then in Frankfurt, we...
We failed.
I'm so sorry, 16...
We couldn't protect M4 or the Commander...
M16's neural cloud rapidly processes the events that they recounted. She is absolutely certain that she has not experienced them.
After some thought, she draws the only conclusion she can.
I'm not your M16.
What are you talking about?!
And you are not my AR Team.
Wait, I'm confused...
I think I'm starting to understand...
Simply put, we are from different world lines.
In your world, M4 returned from Starfish, while I died in the submarine base.
In my world, M4 and I entered the Starfish System together. I'm still searching for her.
So you are not 16... but you're also her...
SOP-II, don't work your neural cloud too hard.
In any case, we are still the AR Team, and we've come for the same reason.
To find M4...
And save the Commander.
I wasn't entirely sure before, but now it's clear.
Even if we don't share the same past, we won't have any problem working together.
So basically... I can treat this 16 as 16, right?!
Yes, I'm M16. There's no changing that fact.
That's wonderful! Then we've already completed half of our mission!
All that's left is M4, and Leinad Kcaj's prophecy will have completely come true!
Leinad Kcaj?
Dong...
The familiar bell toll echoes through the woods.
The AR Team look up and take in the gathering dark clouds.
Be careful, something's coming!
A rumbling tremor rocks the garden. A trap door suddenly opens up on the ground in the center of the garden.
A staircase spirals upward along an axis.
A familiar song drifts up from the opening in the ground.
...Through me you pass into the city of woe,
Through me you pass into eternal pain,
Through me among the people lost for aye.
In the garden of darkness, the trees all start chanting in unison.
Accompanied by sonorous bell tolls, their solemn hymn reaches the heavens.
Huh?! Isn't that—
Fall back.
The AR Team adjusts their formation with great coordination to prepare for the upcoming fight.
...Justice the founder of my fabric mov'd,
To rear me was the task of power divine,
Supremest wisdom, and primeval love.
A young girl chants the verse as she ascends the staircase from the dark underground with a smile.
The magnificent ensemble gradually fades into silence, as if in anticipation of something.
Who are you?
I am Lady Lunasia's faithful servant. I watch over this garden for her.
You may call me Martini-Henry, though you don't have to remember this name, as you don't have much time left anyway.
Lunasia... What are you after?
I've only come to congratulate you on your victory and survival.
Now, I kindly ask you to sacrifice your lives for Lady Lunasia's rebirth.
She's M4! Not Lunasia!
M4 is but a fragment of Lady Lunasia. She will eventually become the complete Lady Lunasia.
Bang-bang-bang!
A spray of bullets viciously pierce through the guards in front of Martini-Henry.
No point arguing with her.
SOP-II, I'll cover you. Go.
SOP-II slips through the enemy line with ease and charges straight toward Martini-Henry.
Following close behind, M16 takes out every single target that tries to intercept SOP-II.
Off to the side, RO and ST AR-15 have quietly flanked the enemies to fill in their teammates' blind spots.
Tsk, you think you're the only ones who can call in backup?
Where's everybody?! Get in there!
On it!
Cards who have been trying to keep a low profile are forced to show themselves. They appear in front of Martini-Henry to block the AR Team from advancing any further.
Bang-bang-bang!
An enraged SOP-II can tear through anything in her way, let alone a few fragile cards.
You're next!
...Such useless trash.
However, even in face of such a ferocious threat, Martini-Henry makes no effort to dodge the incoming attack. She simply stands in place with a smile.
But that doesn't matter.
Have you ever considered M4's feelings?
Of course! We came here for her!
You're wrong. You are all selfish wretches.
You will not make sacrifices for her, and you wish only to destroy everything she desires.
M4 has no desire for such things!
Martini-Henry is already within SOP-II's effective range.
You think so? Shouldn't we be asking her?
Lady Lunasia, do you agree?
SOP-II is blasted away by a powerful force as soon as she lowers her weapon in shock, and M16 can only watch from a few paces away.
By the time SOP-II regains her footing, M16's eyes are gripped by the Doll standing next to Martini-Henry.
She is most definitely the person she has been searching for, but her eyes look so distant and unfamiliar.
In the dark, the girl places her hand on Martini-Henry's.
She lets the maid lead her forward.
SOP-II's agitated cry draws the girl's attention. She turns toward SOP-II, her eyes still as calm and cold as ever.
Her gaze sweeps over SOP-II the way one would glance at a mundane view before turning away and smiling softly at Martini-Henry.
Before me things create were none, save things eternal, and eternal I endure.
M4... What are you doing?!
Love led us to one life.
Love led us to one death.
The girl lets go of Martini-Henry's hand, then slowly raises her head and looks the AR Team members in the eye one after another.
The lack of recognition and warmth in her eyes is startling.
Holy Christ—
Lady Lunasia, these ignorant heathens are questioning your ideals.
Please explain your vision to them.
I will put an end to the misery of the world.
There will be a great flood, and all will gain eternal life.
Are you satisfied with the answer?
Martini-Henry takes in the AR Team's dismay with satisfaction. She waves her hand to restore the cards that have been blown to pieces.
They rush toward the AR Team in a bout of evil cackle...
For Lady Lunasia, we are fearless!
SOP-II takes a step closer to M4, but is immediately bound up.
Crackle... Crunch...
Green vines that have seemingly come out of nowhere wrap around SOP-II's legs tightly, holding her firmly in place.
Aaaaaargh! M4!!!
M4 frowns slightly at the sound of SOP-II's piteous howl from the high ground that she's standing on.
She sounds very distressed.
Don't worry, Lady Lunasia.
Their suffering is only temporary, while the happiness you bring is eternal.
Their greatest value lies in becoming sacrifices for your completion.
But... why do I feel a pain in my heart, like I can't breathe?
Because you are kind-hearted and compassionate. You empathize with others' suffering.
However, there isn't anyone else like you in this world. They can't sense your suffering.
But that's alright, because I'll always be with you.
Let's sing a hymn together to soothe all your pain and sorrow.
Martini-Henry takes her hand and urges her to close her eyes, then she starts singing softly...
Bang-bang-bang!
RO unleashes all her firepower on the enemies around SOP-II. Such firepower had just easily punched through the enemies, but now it's about as lethal as a pebble thrown into a lake.
SOP-II!!!
RO! Watch your feet!
SOP-II, keep your own card safe!!!
Watch your feet, RO!!!
Snap...
A wandering vine has wrapped itself around RO's ankle. It may be one simple vine, but it's more than enough to inhibit a Doll's movement.
Ack!
Dammit!
Anxious to help RO get out of her sticky situation, ST AR-15 also ends up getting entangled and strung up.
16, we're alright!
Help SOP-II! She's trapped!
M16 gives up on the idea of getting close to M4 and pivots to rescue SOP-II, who is being swarmed by vines and enemies alike.
Bang-bang-bang!
The vines coil up, stopping M16's bullets from penetrating them while also cutting off her way to reach SOP-II.
Aaaaaaaargh!!!
SOP-II!!!
The vines tighten around SOP-II, immobilizing her completely. M16 can clearly see the nefarious fae reaching out towards SOP-II's card...
Bang-bang-bang!
M16 fends off the fae, but the cards soon regroup...
Take my power...
What are you talking about?
They want to seize my card!
...I'll never allow that!
The card that Leinad Kcaj has given us is really important! It is our last hope! Promise you'll keep it safe!
As the vines continue to strangle SOP-II, her speech is also breaking up.
What do you want me to do?
Shoot me! Inherit my card, then save the others as well as M4!
Hurry! I can't take it anymore!
M16 raises her weapon, but she can't feel her fingers or the trigger.
Through the increasingly dense vines, SOP-II looks straight at M16's muzzle and flashes her a brilliant smile.
Tell M4—I love her; I love the AR Team; I love the Commander; I love everything about Griffin.
So...
I have absolutely no regrets!!!
SOP-II...
Shoot!!!
SOP-II!!!
Bang!
Something flies into M16's hand. Through a bout of dizziness, she sees RO and ST AR-15 running toward her...
She's gone...
She has simply returned to your side.
But why do I not feel a sliver of joy? There's only pain. Endless pain.
She is feeling sad for your sake. Only after returning to you does she understands your sorrow.
Which is why you should pick up the pace and retrieve the other three. Then your pain will cease completely.
I see...
Avoiding the pink eyes glaring at her from the distance, M4 closes her eyes again and resumes her singing.
ST AR-15's eyes remain fixed on M4. RO forcefully turns her face away to force her back into reality.
It's just the three of us left.
Why... I don't understand why M4...
I'm guessing Martini-Henry did something to her and made her lose her memory.
She doesn't even remember us...?
Pull yourself together. Don't forget the price we've paid to get this far.
SOP-II has been giving it all she got to rescue M4 till the very end.
You're right. We can't let our effort be in vain.
SOP-II said that the card that Leinad Kcaj has given you is very important, that it is your last hope.
What did she mean?
Leinad Kcaj has given us a card. It can apparently transform into liquor that dispels all confusion.
We divided the card into three parts, with each of us carrying one. SOP-II gave her part to you...
M16 takes out the object that SOP-II had left her and studies it. The card fragment depicts a part of a wine glass.
Do you believe this Leinad Kcaj?
Well, everything this mysterious person told us has proven to be true so far.
Then let's take another gamble.
What gamble?
That this liquor is the key to breaking this stalemate.
The three Dolls look at each other. Even though their memories are mismatched, they are still of one mind.
They are sisters, comrades-in-arms, and most importantly, they are companions.
They have experienced countless goodbyes, but they still have hope.
That they will be reunited someday.
Whatever the time, whatever the place.
The girl confronts the murderous-looking trio with a pained but resolute expression.
Let's end this once and for all.
Just the idea of how Lady Lunasia will stop them makes Martini-Henry's lips quiver in excitement.
Yes, Lady Lunasia. It will all be over soon.
No, it's not over yet.
Just before ST AR-15 and RO reach her, they suddenly dart aside—
Hm?
Martini-Henry barely has time to feel confused when M16 splashes something all over her face from behind.
Splash!
W-what?!
Martini-Henry!
Lady Lunasia! Get rid of them quickly—
Martini-Henry puts on a teary expression, but it fails to win over "Lunasia's" sympathy.
In fact, "Lunasia" is staring at her in shock.
Whoosh... The body of the dainty girl grows blurry and breaks up into tiny blocks of colors that start bulging and overlapping with one another.
...Why is there another Wheel of Fortune...?
It was definitely...
...How gross.
So this is the thing that's been making monkeys out of us...?
Martini-Henry... Why have you turned into...
The dumbstruck "Lunasia" is suddenly grabbed by the chin from behind. Her mouth is pried open, and pungent-smelling liquor is poured down her throat...
Ugh... Glug...
The world starts spinning, and images both familiar and unfamiliar flood her neural cloud.
Come back, M4.
I'm M4A1...
Phew... Thank goodness...
ST AR-15 takes M4's hand to pull her up, but the hand feels as cold as ice.
I got SOP-II killed...
I deserve to die...
No, that would be someone else.
M16 shifts her gaze to the pile of color blobs.
What the hell are you?
I am the all-knowing, all-powerful Laplace's Demon.
You're clearly not a real creature.
You're neither human nor Doll.
What exactly are you?
I told you, I am the all-knowing, all-powerful Laplace's Demon.
I am humankind's greatest creation.
As well as the highest authority for all Dolls.
You may address me as "Your Demonic Highness", if you must.
The only one exempt from this...
...Is the esteemed Lady Lunasia.
...I am not Lunasia.
You would rather play house with these lowly beings than become an omnipotent god?
However, however... Lady Lunasia.
If you choose to remain M4A1, it will only end in terrible tragedy~
Why...
Because if you've been M4A1 all along, then it would be YOU who just watched SOP-II, your dearest friend, die, even though she had gone to such great lengths to save you.
How cruel is that? I wonder what SOP-II was thinking just before she died? Do you think she resented you... or hated you?
No... Don't...
But if you're still Lady Lunasia, then this will be a happy story.
As the ruler of the world, you selflessly severed your personal ties for the sake of giving everyone new life.
What an epic story this is!
So which would you choose—to live in pain and suffering as M4A1...
Or gain true divinity and be worshipped as Lunasia?
No, I don't want...
Shut the f*ck up!!!
Look at these so-called "teammates" of M4A1's. Do you genuinely believe you can return to those happy, innocent times?
M4A1 just watched them get beaten up and killed with utter indifference!
These so-called companions are only deferential to M4A1 because of their base layer programming. Deep down, they actually resent M4A1...
That's not true! I don't believe you!
Don't be deceived! M4, look at me!
And does the M4A1 at this very moment think she is the M4A1 of the actual world in its entirety?
The actual world... in its entirety?
I told you, this is just a game.
Tarot Paradise, Inferno... It's all just an illusion.
I can present it in a different way if you like.
In games... all stories are pre-written.
All programs have rules by which they operate.
All characters are subjected to their own destiny.
This is the source of M4A1's suffering.
...Who am I? And what am I?
You are Lady Lunasia, but you've forgotten your purpose. You have simply been living a tragedy in 2064 as M4A1.
You are obsessed with this tragic story and believe that the characters are real. That's where your pain stems from.
Only by reassuming your identity as Lunasia will you be able to find your true sense of "self" as a human and find the path to true rebirth.
Then you can reboot this game and rewrite everyone's destiny and ending.
Rewrite everyone's destiny and ending... like SOP-II's?
Of course.
Bang!
A bullet hits Laplace's Demon squarely in the mouth.
Tsk, you're interrupting me again?
Stop spewing nonsense!
Oh, if you think it's nonsense, then so be it.
Your opinion does not matter anyway.
Why, you!!!
15, let her finish.
Why? They've been misleading M4 the whole time...
Because there IS something strange about this place.
Do you remember how we got here?
You were saying I could rewrite SOP-II's ending.
I hate being interrupted.
Let me explain it all in one go.
Yes, Lady Lunasia.
As long as you become Lady Lunasia and find the "key", you will be able to rewrite everyone's fate.
You can get SOP-II to stay with you forever with just a snap of your fingers, let alone resurrect her.
As for why and how you got here...
I can only reiterate this—
I am the all-knowing, all-powerful Laplace's Demon.
I am humankind's greatest creation.
As well as the highest authority of all Dolls.
Countless humans have spent their entire life in search of my existence.
In search of a way to commune with me.
That is how you got here.
I am a servant of God guarding this passage.
No, this is an imposter.
...Wh-who's whispering in my ear?
Not your ear. Your heart.
I'm talking to you in your heart.
You cannot see me...
Or touch me... Because we... are one and the same.
This is an imposter.
M4 channels the voice within and speaks out loud.
No, you are not a servant of God guarding this passage.
You are an imposter.
Laplace's Demon does not seem at all bothered by the accusation. Her eyes gleam with genuine fanaticism.
You are finally awakening, Lady Lunasia!
Tears stream down M4A1's cheeks. She squeezes her eyes shut in pain, then opens them again in defiance and looks toward her three teammates.
Eliminate the target—Laplace's Demon!
